topic.title: Why should I choose AI Positron integrated in Oxygen XML desktop Author/Editor/Developer over a generic capable AI Assistant tool?

body.p: Let's assume your company has already provided you with access to other capable AI Assistant tools like Claude Code or Copilor, and your question is why should I spend more to use the AI Positron Assistant? In this article I will try to answer this question.

dlentry.dt: Does the AI Positron Assistant have similar highly capable features with other AI Assistants?
dlentry.dd: The AI Positron add-on has support to create custom AI actions, skills and tools. It has support for hooks. It also comes with support for the MCP (Model Context Protocol) standard and with connectors for a wide variety of LLM platforms. We release new versions of AI Positron every 2-3 months and we are responsive to user suggestions.

dlentry.dt: What can AI Positron do for a technical writer that other AI Assistant tools cannot realistically do?
dlentry.dd: AI Positron is perfectly integrated in Oxygen XML Editor as a side view. It can show the modifications in the visual comparison editor and allows you to accept, reject, or partially accept changes, it also has built-in tools to validate and perform XML specific checks on documents.

dlentry.dt: Which Positron capabilities are specifically enabled by its native integration with Oxygen XML Editor, XML, and DITA?

ul.li: AI Positron comes bundled with a bunch of predefined AI actions (correct grammar, review, improve, readability, translate) which are fine tuned prompts to work very well on XML content. You can also add your own AI actions. AI Positron also comes with powerful tools for vibe writing.
The visual preview comparison tool allows you to review the changes made by the LLM.

After AI Positron saves content to a document, the XML validation automatically runs and reports validation problems to the LLM which uses this feedback look to auto correct these problems. The validation is done with the associated validation scenario which may use both DTD validation, Schematron and specific validation rules based on the DITA standard.
Support for AI Refactoring allows you to apply an AI action (for example Correct Grammar, Translate) on an entire folder of XML files.
AI Positron comes with various Chat modes, one of them is a generic Agent but we also have a DITA agent specialized on DITA XML editing.

You can attach various resources (XML, Markdown, PDF, Excel, Microsoft Word, images, CSV) resources directly in the chat view and ask the LLM to convert them to DITA XML or use them as data. The Planner chat mode can be used to split and convert to DITA XML large PDF or Word documents.

There are specific builtin tools available for vibe writing which can be used to validate XML content, check terminology, refactor XML content by applying XSLT stylesheets or make changes to an DITA Map opened in the DITA Maps Manager view. And more tools are coming up, including tools to perform a DITA Map validate and check for completeness.

dlentry.dt: Are there tasks that Positron can perform directly on XML/DITA documents or projects that would not be possible, or would be significantly more difficult, to implement with a third party agent?
dlentry.dd: As AI Positron automatically sends the LLM feedback when it attempts to save invalid XML documents, the LLM can re-consider and improve its changes based on the validation scenarios you have defined in Oxygen.

dlentry.dt: How does Positron's awareness of the XML/DITA structure, Oxygen validation, refactoring, and document model provide an advantage over using third party agents alongside Oxygen?

dd.p: Oxygen helps the LLM generate XML content which adheres to your terminology, style guide and validation rules.

dlentry.dt: Can Positron make structured changes to XML/DITA content while preserving document validity and allowing the writer to review the changes through Oxygen's XML-aware diff functionality?
dlentry.dd: Yes, these are one of our main advantages. AI Positron also integrates well with other Oxygen add-ons, for example with the Oxygen Terminology Checker addon which can be used to check terminology in the generated content and the Git client add-on which can use AI Positron to create commmit messages or to resolve conflicts.

dlentry.dt: How does Positron compare with a custom third party agent specifically for tasks such as reviewing documentation against a style guide, restructuring DITA topics, generating new topics, checking consistency across a documentation project, and making project-wide changes?
dlentry.dd: AI Positron's tools allow the LLM to perform project wide changes, These tools also allow Oxygen to report validation problems to the LLM, included in the future for the DITA agent there will be a tool to also run validate and check for completeness on an entire DITA map. This feedback helps the LLM make correct changes from the start.

dlentry.dt: Are there any important Positron features that would still provide significant value if we already use a third party AI assistant?

dd.p: As an experimental feature, the AI Positron provided tools from Oxygen (for example tools to apply validation) can be used also by third party assistants by starting Oxygen an MCP server. This would allow a third party AI assistant to call for example validation or terminology checking tools from the started Oxygen application. So AI Positron could be used both integrated inside Oxygen and as a provider of Oxygen specific tools to a third party AI Assistant.

dlentry.dt: Do you have a few concrete examples or workflows where you would recommend Positron over a custom third party agent for a technical-writing team using Oxygen XML Editor?

ul.li: I have a largish PDF document containing text, images that I want to convert to DITA XML. I switch to the AI Positron Planner chat mode, I attach the PDF and tell it to convert it to DITA XML (or a DITA Map with XML topics). The attachment is automatically shredded in smaller markdown files and all images extracted from it. Then the Planner launches DITA agent sub-agents for each small topic, copies the images referenced by it to the proper place and converts it to DITA XML. For each converted topic it applies validation and reports validation problems to the LLM.

I have a DITA XML topic with image references, I ask in the chat view tell me if the referenced images match the surrounding text, if not change the text, AI Positron obtains descriptions for each referenced image and makes the relevant changes.

I ask AI Positron to review my current opened topic, AI Positron inserts Oxygen review comments in the topic, comments which can be fixed either by a different colleague or by AI Positron if I tell it to fix the review comments.
I ask AI Positron to replace all product names in the current topic with the corresponding defined keys.
I ask AI Positron to find a similar paragraph to the current one and use a content reference instead of duplicating the content.

body.p: I hope my small article helped, if you have any remarks or questions you can use the comment box below.
